- Duplicate video files defect (5 records, 2 ETag groups) — requires owner to upload unique video files or remove duplicate records from DB

## Key Decisions
- Added QueryClient defaults globally rather than per-query overrides — single config prevents refetch storms across all 135 React Query files
- Wired NetworkProvider inside EmailProvider boundary — ensures onlineManager connected before any screen mounts
- Switched DealVideoCard, HoldingCard, TrustDealCard from RN Image to expo-image — enables native caching, fade transitions, memory-disk cachePolicy
- Gated registration/health behind Bearer auth — was publicly exposing `serviceKeyAvailable` boolean (security leak)
- Reels stress test simulates player lifecycle in pure logic (no device needed) — 500 cycles, max 3 concurrent, zero leaks
- removeClippedSubviews intentionally disabled in videos.tsx — documented Android bug with pagingEnabled
- Custom accent colors (#4ECDC4, #FF6B35, #A78BFA) in profit-tools.tsx deemed acceptable — used for tool category differentiation, not brand surfaces

3. Commit all Phase 2 + 9 fixes to GitHub

5. Owner action: configure SMTP, run physical device QA on Samsung Browser
